notes.title: UPDATE DEMO - Deadly Laser Card, Card Auras, and In-depth Threat Level
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/2a170c75263970abf461d05a67fa6de48aee332e.png"]   
This is the commander speaking! 


With the Six One Indie Game Showcase just around the corner, we are excited to release an updated demo of Mini Tank Mayhem. This update introduces a range of new features and improvements, including a powerful new card the death ray from the sky...TLDR !! 

This update also includes enhanced visuals, refined gameplay settings, and various balance adjustments. Players can now experience Threat Level 3, and enjoy the addition of rarity-based card auras. These changes aim to provide a more engaging, polished, and enjoyable demo experience as we celebrate Six One Indie Game festival.


Changelog:General 
Added new card: TL;DR 

Added card aura based on rarity 

Added Threat Level 3 

Added trusty companion bot that gives commendations to players 

Improved companion bot dialogue 

Added photosensitivity warning when launching the game 

Added background scenery in Grassland 

Added tooltip during “Pick an Artifact” 

Improved tank card visuals 

Improved visuals on the Portal 

Improved visuals on map nodes 

Improved material shading on enemies, tanks, and stages 

Improved scoring mechanic 

Render pipeline switched to Universal Render Pipeline (URP) (from Built-in) 

Removed sound effects when enemies die 

Removed all commander special abilities 
Bug Fixes 
Fixed tutorial soft-lock when placing the wrong tank 

Fixed tutorial confusion due to lack of placement indication 

Fixed Bio-Mecha Tank not dealing damage 

Fixed Nav-path of Blaster Galapa (boss now moves properly) 

Fixed Observer not applying its effect to all tanks 

Fixed “Repair Base” being usable at Rest Stop when HP is full 

Fixed range display of tanks and spells not showing 

Fixed “Free Pass” artifact increasing instead of decreasing 

Fixed UI scalability 

Fixed map node displaying red lines on all nodes 

Fixed map moves by itself strangely when idle (Map still auto-move and highlight the current stage) 
Balance 
Reduced Notbat health from 65 to 50 

Reduced Falco health from 45 to 35 

Reduced Rhinos health from 40 to 30 

Increased Burn damage from 2 to 3 

Increased Burn duration from 5 to 6 

Increased Flamethrower attack speed from 5 to 7 

Reduced Flamethrower attack power from 2 to 1 

Reduced Basic Mold attack power from 10 to 8 

Increased Sniper cost from 1 to 3 

Increased Sniper range from 95 to 110 

Increased Attacker cost from 1 to 2 

Increased Attacker attack power from 8 to 9 

Increased Mega Attacker cost from 3 to 4 

Increased Mega Attacker attack power from 8 to 10 

Increased Mega Attacker range from 60 to 70 

Increased Catapult cost from 2 to 3 

Increased Catapult attack power from 12 to 15 

Increased 8x Scope module range bonus from +20 to +30
